intro: Micah Parsons makes his Packers debut tonight against the Rams, and Thanksgiving brings a first-place showdown between the Bears and Lions. Patrick Mahomes is playing through elbow and knee trouble ahead of a trip to Buffalo, and Dak Prescott has Dallas rolling into Thursday. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Micah Parsons is cleared to play the Rams, 346 days after his ACL tear
top.dek: The Packers activated Parsons on Tuesday, and he can play tonight on Thanksgiving Eve. Green Bay is 6-4 and last in the NFC North. Parsons had 12.5 sacks last season in 14 games.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Mahomes plays through elbow and knee problems before Buffalo
top.dek: Patrick Mahomes has thrown for 672 yards and eight touchdowns over his last two games despite the injuries. He said last week he has not had the burst he wants. The Chiefs are 8-2 and visit Buffalo on Thanksgiving night.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: Dak Prescott throws for 325 yards and four touchdowns against Tennessee
top.dek: Prescott also scored on a red-zone scramble. CeeDee Lamb caught 11 of 12 targets for 132 yards, and George Pickens added seven catches for 102 yards. The Cowboys host the Eagles on Thanksgiving.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: 6: straight touchdown drives to open the Cowboys' win over Tennessee
top.dek: Dallas scored a touchdown on each of its first six possessions Sunday, the longest such start in the franchise's play-by-play era. The Cowboys reached the end zone seven times in all.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Bears at Lions on Thanksgiving with first place in the NFC North on the line
top.dek: Both teams are 8-2, and the winner takes sole possession of first. Kickoff is Thursday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS at Ford Field. Caleb Williams is 0-4 against Detroit in his career.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Bills face Chiefs with Allen's turnovers in focus

stories.text: Allen's turnovers loom over a Thanksgiving test with Kansas City
stories.summary: Buffalo sits at 9-1 and gets Kansas City at home on Thanksgiving night. Josh Allen has thrown five interceptions in the last four games, two of them against Miami, and he called one a bad decision. The defense has tightened since the bye, so the offense's mistakes are the main way the Chiefs get back in this one.

stories.text: Kincaid and Benford practice in limited fashion
stories.summary: Tight end Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle) sat out Week 11 and was limited Monday and Tuesday. Cornerback Christian Benford (groin) went from a non-participant Monday to limited Tuesday. Guard O'Cyrus Torrence (ankle) and defensive end T.J. Sanders (shoulder) were also limited Tuesday, and receiver Joshua Palmer is on injured reserve with a hamstring injury.

stories.text: Rousseau keeps piling up pressure
stories.summary: Edge rusher Greg Rousseau has 10 sacks, the most by a Bills player since Leonard Floyd in 2023 and a career high. He led the NFL with 56 pressures entering Week 11, then added two sacks and two hurries against Miami. Expect Buffalo to lean on him to bother Patrick Mahomes.

stories.text: 37: points the Bills have allowed in four games since the bye
stories.summary: Buffalo gave up 171 points in its first six games, 28.5 per game. Since the bye, Baltimore, Minnesota, the Jets and Miami have scored a combined 37, and none topped 12. Several of those opponents played backup quarterbacks, which tempers the number a little.

stories.text: Chiefs at Bills, Thursday night on NBC
stories.summary: Buffalo hosts Kansas City (8-2) Thursday, Nov. 26 at 8:20 PM ET on NBC, with a Peacock stream, at Highmark Stadium. Allen is 5-1 against Mahomes in the regular season, but Mahomes has won all four playoff meetings. Watch Allen's turnovers and how Buffalo handles Travis Kelce.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Dolphins sink to 1-9 as McCord struggles

stories.text: Hafley defends McCord after 26-9 loss in Buffalo
stories.summary: Miami fell to 1-9, its worst start since the 2007 team opened 0-13. Quarterback Kyle McCord went 12 of 33 for 102 yards in his second career start, and all nine points came from field goals. Coach Jeff Hafley said the team needs to help him more, and he praised edge rusher Chop Robinson.

stories.text: Willis seeks a second opinion as injuries pile up
stories.summary: Quarterback Malik Willis went on injured reserve in Week 10 and is seeking a second opinion after his injury spread to his abdomen. Hafley said surgery is not foreseen at this time, though sources differ on how likely it is. Cornerback JuJu Brents (shoulder) is day to day, and safety Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder, groin) sat out Week 11. Running back De'Von Achane is out for the season with a torn ACL.

stories.text: Rookie Rodriguez stands out in a lost game
stories.summary: Rookie linebacker Jacob Rodriguez made 13 tackles and returned an interception 26 yards against Buffalo. Safety Zayne Anderson also picked off Josh Allen. The defense forced two turnovers, but the offense could not turn them into touchdowns.

stories.text: 2 of 14: Miami's third-down conversions against Buffalo
stories.summary: The Dolphins converted two of 14 third downs and held the ball for about 23 minutes to Buffalo's nearly 37. Hafley pointed to dropped passes and said his team has to finish drives with touchdowns instead of field goals.

stories.text: Jets visit Miami on Sunday at 1 PM
stories.summary: Miami hosts the Jets (3-8) Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1:00 PM ET on CBS at Hard Rock Stadium. Miami's lone win this season was a 28-25 victory over New York on Oct. 25, per the preview. Watch whether McCord can find a rhythm against a Jets pass rush led by rookie David Bailey.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: Patriots stick with DeVito after Maye injury

stories.text: Vrabel says 'Tommy's our starter' with Maye sidelined
stories.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel confirmed Tommy DeVito will start Sunday at the Chargers after the bye. The Patriots (5-5) have seven games left, and Drake Maye is reportedly out at least six weeks. Only DeVito and rookie Behren Morton are on the roster at quarterback, and Vrabel does not expect a signing soon.

stories.text: Maye, Brown and Doubs all missing from the lineup
stories.summary: Maye has a fractured fibula and stays on the 53-man roster. Receiver A.J. Brown (hamstring) is doubtful, and Vrabel does not expect him Sunday. Receiver Romeo Doubs and running back TreVeyon Henderson are on injured reserve, and cornerback Carlton Davis III (knee) is also in question.

stories.text: DeVito skipped the bye to prepare
stories.summary: DeVito gave up his bye week rest and treated it like a normal game week. In his first game replacing Maye, against Detroit, he completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards with one touchdown and one interception. On the season he has 132 passing yards and a 50 percent completion rate.

stories.text: 16-3: New England's playoff win over the Chargers last season
stories.summary: The Patriots beat Los Angeles 16-3 in last year's playoffs. This time the Chargers are 1-9 and the Patriots are coming off two straight losses before the bye. The game total is set at only 35.5, which tells you how little offense the oddsmakers expect.

stories.text: Patriots at Chargers, Sunday at 4:05 PM on CBS
stories.summary: New England visits Los Angeles Sunday, Nov. 29 at 4:05 PM ET on CBS at SoFi Stadium. The game moved out of primetime. Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert entered concussion protocol after last week's loss, so watch his status and how the Patriots' offense works without Maye and Brown.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets snap five-game skid with win in LA

stories.text: Jets beat Chargers 27-24 to end a five-game losing streak
stories.summary: The Jets improved to 3-8 at SoFi Stadium behind a clean offensive day: Geno Smith went 17 of 21 for 176 yards. Offensive coordinator Frank Reich called plays from the sideline for the first time this season. The defense sacked Justin Herbert six times.

stories.text: Cooper, Wallace and Williams all in doubt for Miami
stories.summary: Receiver Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle, hip) has not played since leaving Week 10. Linebacker Trevin Wallace (groin) sat out Week 11, and receiver Isaiah Williams (ribs) is also questionable. Smith played through a left ankle issue and showed no ill effects.

stories.text: Shepard scores twice after a practice squad call-up
stories.summary: Sterling Shepard caught two touchdown passes from Smith, the first two-score game of his career. He was elevated from the practice squad for the third time this season, so the Jets must add him to the 53-man roster to keep using him. Breece Hall also caught a 7-yard score.

stories.text: 9.5: rookie David Bailey's sacks through 10 games
stories.summary: Bailey had two sacks against the Chargers, and he is half a sack short of the Jets rookie record. He also has six forced fumbles. The Jets sacked Herbert six times in all.

stories.text: Jets at Dolphins, Sunday at 1 PM on CBS
stories.summary: New York visits Miami (1-9) Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1:00 PM ET on CBS at Hard Rock Stadium. The Jets are small road favorites. The question is whether the offense that played turnover free against the Chargers can repeat the performance.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens chase a win after six straight losses

stories.text: Ravens drop sixth straight in 35-33 loss to Panthers
stories.summary: Baltimore started 4-1 and has lost every game since. Jacoby Brissett threw an interception with under a minute left against Carolina, and the Ravens still have no firm return date for Lamar Jackson, who went on injured reserve after thumb surgery.

stories.text: Jackson stays on IR, defensive line questions pile up
stories.summary: Jackson is recovering from surgery on a broken and dislocated right thumb, and coach Jesse Minter put his absence at six to 10 weeks. Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) and safety Jaylinn Hawkins (left knee) are on the Week 12 report, and Madubuike missed the Panthers game with the same hamstring. Final designations come later this week.

stories.text: Brissett keeps Baltimore in shootouts
stories.summary: Brissett went 24 of 37 for 276 yards and a touchdown against Carolina, with a 52-yard trick-play score to Rashod Bateman. The Ravens acquired him from Arizona on Nov. 6, and he has since taken over the offense.

stories.text: 6: straight losses since a 4-1 start
stories.summary: Baltimore has not won since the first month of the season. The Ravens gave up 120 rushing yards and two scores to Carolina's Chuba Hubbard last week.

stories.text: At Houston, Sunday 1:00 PM ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Ravens visit a Texans team missing pass rusher Danielle Hunter, with receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. uncertain and running back Woody Marks still in the concussion protocol. Watch whether Baltimore can slow Houston's two-back run game after Hubbard's day.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Bengals look to reset after last-second loss

stories.text: Commanders kick winner as time expires, 22-20
stories.summary: Evan McPherson's 56-yard field goal put Cincinnati up 20-19 with 46 seconds left, but Jayden Daniels hit two deep throws and Drew Stevens won it from 26 yards. The loss snapped the Bengals' win streak and leaves them 7-3 on a short week.

stories.text: Dugger and Risner questionable, Burks lost to IR
stories.summary: Safety Kyle Dugger (left quadriceps) and guard Dalton Risner (knees) head the Week 12 report. Linebacker Oren Burks went on injured reserve with a groin injury, and Jalen Rivers made his first start of the year at right guard Monday.

stories.text: Boye Mafe piles up three first-half sacks
stories.summary: Mafe set a career high with three sacks, all before halftime, and finished with five tackles. His 9.5 sacks lead the Bengals this season.

stories.text: 3,095: Burrow leads the NFL in passing yards
stories.summary: Joe Burrow went 28 of 40 for 300 yards and two touchdowns against Washington, his fourth 300-yard game of the year. He has 29 touchdowns and six interceptions on the season.

stories.text: Home vs. Saints, Sunday 1:00 PM ET on CBS
stories.summary: Cincinnati hosts 3-7 New Orleans at Paycor Stadium and is a double-digit favorite. Watch how the offense gets Ja'Marr Chase involved after he finished with 31 yards Monday.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Rested Browns get a Sunday night stage

stories.text: Raiders game moves to Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: The NFL flexed Las Vegas at Cleveland from 1:00 PM to Sunday night. It will be the first Sunday night game in Cleveland since 2019, and the Browns come off a bye with a 27-24 win over Houston.

stories.text: Hickman in concussion protocol, IR list is long
stories.summary: Safety Ronnie Hickman is on the Week 12 report with a concussion. Guard Teven Jenkins and linebacker Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah sit on injured reserve, and tackle Kalia Davis is out for the year. Defensive end Derek Barnett left the Houston game with a hamstring injury.

stories.text: Watson delivers again in the fourth quarter
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson threw for 312 yards, ran for 50 and a score, and led a three-play, 49-yard drive to set up Quinshon Judkins' winning 5-yard run with 53 seconds left. Cleveland erased a 17-point deficit.

stories.text: 1963: last time Cleveland started 4-0 at home
stories.summary: The Browns are 4-0 for the first time since 1963, and all six of their wins have come by four points or fewer.

stories.text: Home vs. Raiders, Sunday 8:20 PM ET on NBC/Peacock
stories.summary: Las Vegas is 4-6 and starts rookie Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 overall pick. Cleveland beat the Raiders 24-10 last year. Watch if the Browns can hold up late in another close game.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers face Broncos on short Black Friday week

stories.text: DK Metcalf avoids suspension after ejection
stories.summary: The NFL will not suspend Metcalf for the ejection in Sunday's 19-16 loss to Philadelphia, so he can play Friday. Fines are still possible. Metcalf denies trying to poke Eagles corner Cooper DeJean in the eye.

stories.text: Highsmith unlikely, Pittman expected back
stories.summary: Linebacker Alex Highsmith (ankle) is unlikely to play, and Nick Herbig (hip) is on the report. Coach Mike McCarthy said he is very confident receiver Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) will play. Reports on Pittman's exact status conflict, so check Thursday's practice report.

stories.text: Max Hurleman steps up from the practice squad
stories.summary: Hurleman had six catches for 61 yards and a touchdown on seven targets in Week 11, including a 20-yard score from Aaron Rodgers with 1:21 left. Pittman's return could shrink his role.

stories.text: 103: points in Pittsburgh's last five games
stories.summary: Denver has scored 139 in the same stretch. The Steelers have lost two straight and Rodgers has averaged roughly 150 passing yards over his last three starts.

stories.text: Home vs. Broncos, Friday 3:00 PM ET on Prime Video
stories.summary: Pittsburgh is 4-0 at Acrisure Stadium, and 8-2 Denver arrives on a six-game win streak and ranks fifth in the NFL with 31 sacks.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Texans rout Colts, eye a Ravens game

stories.text: Texans bury Colts 26-3 on Thursday night
stories.summary: Houston beat Indianapolis 26-3 on Thursday night at home and moved to 4-6 after a Week 10 loss at Cleveland. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdown passes, and the ground game gave him room to work. The win kept the Texans in the AFC playoff picture.

stories.text: Harrison and Hunter hamstring strains look short term
stories.summary: Marvin Harrison Jr. and Danielle Hunter both sat out the Colts game with hamstring problems. Hunter has now missed two straight. Aaron Wilson reports both could return for the Ravens game. Running back Woody Marks missed Week 11 with a concussion.

stories.text: Montgomery posts his first 100-yard game as a Texan
stories.summary: David Montgomery carried 26 times for 107 yards against Indianapolis and added 17 receiving yards. It was his first 100-yard day since joining Houston. He cleared a groin issue before the game, though his workload may shrink once Marks returns.

stories.text: 21 of 27: Stroud stays sharp and adds 27 rushing yards
stories.summary: Stroud completed 21 of 27 passes for 194 yards, three touchdowns and one interception against the Colts. He also ran for 27 yards. Nico Collins and Kayshon Boutte each caught a touchdown pass.

stories.text: Ravens visit Houston on Sunday
stories.summary: Houston hosts Baltimore on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. Watch the hamstring updates on Harrison and Hunter, and whether Montgomery keeps the lead role. Baltimore is 4-7.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts cut Jones, hand keys to Richardson

stories.text: Colts waive Daniel Jones and turn to Anthony Richardson
stories.summary: Indianapolis waived quarterback Daniel Jones the day after a 26-3 loss to Houston. Coach Shane Steichen said the quarterback takes a lot of the blame when an offense struggles. The Colts are 3-8 with six losses in their last seven games.

stories.text: Pierce shut down, McGowan hurt in the Houston loss
stories.summary: Wide receiver Alec Pierce, who has a heel injury, is done for 2026, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. He is expected to be ready for next season. Running back Seth McGowan left the Texans game with a hamstring injury, and Steichen said he will miss some time.

stories.text: Richardson gets his first start since late 2024
stories.summary: Anthony Richardson will start against the Giants, his first start since Week 16 of the 2024 season. He gets a full week of practice as the QB1. This year he has thrown only four passes, completing two for 8 yards. Steichen likes the way he can hurt defenses with his legs.

stories.text: 65.4: Jones left as the league's lowest-rated passer
stories.summary: Jones carried a 65.4 passer rating, last in the NFL, when the Colts let him go. His 13 interceptions led the league. He went 12 of 27 for 144 yards and an interception against Houston.

stories.text: Giants come to Indianapolis on Sunday
stories.summary: The Colts host the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on Fox. Richardson's legs and a thin receiver room are the storylines. Riley Leonard could also see time, and Steichen says he will evaluate the position week to week.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars stumble at MetLife, face Titans next

stories.text: Giants edge Jaguars 23-18 and snap the momentum
stories.summary: Jacksonville outgained the Giants 354 yards to 238 but turned the ball over twice and fell to 7-3. Cam Little hit all four field goal tries, yet the offense could not finish drives. The loss followed a 40-23 win at Tennessee.

stories.text: Tuten limited after getting stepped on twice
stories.summary: Running back Bhayshul Tuten left the Giants game in the fourth quarter with a foot and ankle injury. Coach Liam Coen said Monday the re-check was not too bad, and Tuten will have limited practice this week. Quarterback Trevor Lawrence has a cut on his right middle finger.

stories.text: Parker Washington keeps producing as the top target
stories.summary: Washington caught eight passes for 103 yards on 17 targets against the Giants. A fourth-quarter catch was ruled incomplete. A week earlier he set a career high with seven catches for 152 yards and a touchdown against Tennessee.

stories.text: 47: Lawrence throws a season-high 47 passes
stories.summary: Lawrence completed 25 of 47 attempts for 301 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions. The attempt total is his highest of the year. Jacksonville ran for only 77 yards.

stories.text: Jaguars host Titans on Sunday
stories.summary: Jacksonville hosts Tennessee on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on Fox. The Jaguars won the first meeting 40-23 in Nashville on Nov. 15, when Lawrence threw for 352 yards. Watch Tuten's practice status through the week.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Titans fall 51-30 in Dallas, lose Spears

stories.text: Cowboys run past Titans 51-30 in Arlington
stories.summary: Dallas gained 480 yards and 7.6 per play in a 51-30 win over Tennessee. The Titans fell to 1-9 and have lost four straight. They finished with one turnover but could not slow the Cowboys.

stories.text: Spears lands on IR as receiver room thins
stories.summary: Running back Tyjae Spears went on injured reserve Saturday and will miss at least four games. Coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Spears had been playing at about 70 percent with his knee. Wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson is also on IR with an ankle injury, and Carnell Tate played through a shoulder issue.

stories.text: Cam Ward accounts for three touchdowns in a loss
stories.summary: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards and two touchdowns, and he ran for another score. Calvin Ridley caught five passes for 68 yards and a touchdown. The offense kept pace for stretches but the defense could not get stops.

stories.text: 110: Pollard runs for 110 yards in Dallas
stories.summary: Tony Pollard carried 21 times for 110 yards at Dallas. With Spears out, Pollard stays the lead back, and Footballguys expects Nicholas Singleton to see a bigger role.

stories.text: Titans travel to Jacksonville on Sunday
stories.summary: Tennessee plays at Jacksonville on Sunday, Nov. 29 at 1 p.m. ET on Fox. The Jaguars beat the Titans 40-23 on Nov. 15, and Tennessee will look for a better answer to Trevor Lawrence and Parker Washington.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Broncos ride six straight into Black Friday

stories.text: Broncos win six straight, hit the road on a short week
stories.summary: Denver beat Las Vegas 38-24 on Sunday to move to 8-2 and match Kansas City atop the AFC West. Sean Payton's team now turns around fast for a Friday game in Pittsburgh, where rain and wind are in the forecast. The Broncos practiced outdoors Wednesday to get ready for a wet ball.

stories.text: Hufanga is back, Harvey stays out until Week 13
stories.summary: Safety Talanoa Hufanga returned from an ankle injury against the Raiders and broke up a deep pass late. Running back RJ Harvey is on injured reserve and cannot come back before the Week 13 game against Miami.

stories.text: Jonah Coleman runs for three scores against Vegas
stories.summary: Coleman carried 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns in the win over the Raiders. He has now scored on the ground in three straight games. J.K. Dobbins had one carry.

stories.text: 31: sacks for a Denver defense that has allowed 12
stories.summary: The Broncos sacked Fernando Mendoza five times on Sunday, and Jonathon Cooper had two of them. Denver has 31 sacks this season while giving up only 12. Ja'Quan McMillian sealed the game with a 35-yard interception return for a touchdown.

stories.text: Broncos visit the Steelers on Black Friday
stories.summary: Denver (8-2) plays at Pittsburgh (6-4) on Friday, Nov. 27, at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video. The Steelers have lost two straight since their bye, and the Broncos are looking to end their home streak. Watch how Bo Nix handles a wet ball and whether the deep passing game improves.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Mahomes plays through pain before Buffalo

stories.text: Mahomes is playing through elbow and knee issues
stories.summary: Patrick Mahomes has thrown for 672 yards and eight touchdowns over his last two games despite elbow and knee problems. He said last week he has not had the burst he wants. The Chiefs (8-2) head to Buffalo on Thanksgiving night.

stories.text: Walker limited Tuesday, Moore unlikely to return
stories.summary: Running back Kenneth Walker III practiced on a limited basis Tuesday after missing time with groin soreness. Andy Reid said Walker feels good but gave no commitment on his status. Tackle Jaylon Moore has missed two weeks with an ankle injury and looks unlikely to play Thursday.

stories.text: Rookie Emmett Johnson keeps producing in Walker's place
stories.summary: Johnson, a fifth-round pick from Nebraska, has 45 carries for 206 yards and a touchdown in his two starts. He also has 10 catches for 108 yards and two scores. He is the first player since 1994 with 100 rushing yards and 30 receiving yards in each of his first two starts.

stories.text: 672: Mahomes passing yards over the last two games
stories.summary: Mahomes has thrown eight touchdowns in that stretch, in wins over Atlanta and Arizona. Against the Cardinals he went 27 of 39 for 324 yards and three touchdowns with no interceptions. It was his first back-to-back game this season with three or more touchdowns and no picks.

stories.text: Chiefs at Bills on Thanksgiving night
stories.summary: Kansas City (8-2) plays at Buffalo (9-1) on Thursday, Nov. 26, at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC, with a stream on Peacock. Mahomes is 3-2 in road games this season. Watch how the Chiefs run the ball against the Bills, who have the fourth-best run defense by yards allowed.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Raiders chase a win after three straight losses

stories.text: Raiders drop a third straight, head to Cleveland
stories.summary: Las Vegas fell to 4-7 with a 38-24 loss at Denver. Rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza threw the first three touchdown passes of his career but also gave up a late pick-six. The Raiders now play Sunday night at Cleveland.

stories.text: Bowers' ankle leaves his Cleveland status unclear
stories.summary: Tight end Brock Bowers missed the Denver game with an ankle injury suffered against Seattle. He leads the team with 50 catches for 676 yards. His status for Cleveland is not confirmed, and backup Michael Mayer left the Denver game.

stories.text: Mendoza throws for 267 and three scores in defeat
stories.summary: Mendoza completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception against Denver. The Broncos sacked him five times and batted down six of his passes at the line. He now faces a Browns defense that ranked in the top 10 in sacks entering Week 11.

stories.text: 169: Ashton Jeanty's scrimmage yards against Denver
stories.summary: Jeanty ran for 79 yards and caught five passes for 90, including a 68-yard touchdown. He also had a 46-yard run. The Raiders still lost despite out-gaining Denver 370 yards to 351.

stories.text: Raiders visit the Browns on Sunday night
stories.summary: Las Vegas (4-7) plays at Cleveland (6-4) on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC. The Browns come off their bye. Watch whether Bowers returns and how Mendoza handles the Cleveland pass rush.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Herbert in concussion protocol at 1-9

stories.text: Herbert enters concussion protocol after Jets loss
stories.summary: Justin Herbert reported symptoms after Sunday's home loss to the Jets, which dropped the Chargers to 1-9. Jim Harbaugh said Herbert must clear every protocol step before he plays. DJ Uiagalelei is next up at quarterback.

stories.text: Mitchell, Mesidor and Henley all hurting
stories.summary: Running back Keaton Mitchell has a knee injury and is being monitored. Edge Akheem Mesidor has an ankle injury, and linebacker Daiyan Henley was ruled out with a knee injury. Cornerback Tarheeb Still missed the Jets game.

stories.text: Omarion Hampton gains 89 yards on 14 carries
stories.summary: Hampton ripped off a 36-yard run in the loss to the Jets. The Chargers ran 30 times for 158 yards, a 5.3 average. Guard Kayode Awosika played all 60 snaps in place of Cole Strange and allowed one pressure.

stories.text: 318: rushing yards over two weeks, most in the NFL
stories.summary: The Chargers have run for 318 yards across their last two games. The defense gave up a different kind of number against the Jets, who converted nine of 11 third downs. Los Angeles forced no turnovers and no punts.

stories.text: Chargers host the Patriots on Sunday
stories.summary: Los Angeles (1-9) plays New England at SoFi Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 4:05 p.m. ET (1:05 p.m. PT) on CBS. Herbert's availability is the main question, with Uiagalelei and Jake Browning the options behind him.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: Cowboys roll into Thanksgiving off a 51-point day

stories.text: Cowboys hang 51 on Titans, host Eagles on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Dallas beat Tennessee 51-30 and scored touchdowns on its first six drives, the longest opening run in the franchise's play-by-play era. CeeDee Lamb became the first Cowboys receiver with six straight 1,000-yard seasons. The defense still gave up 30, and Christian Parker lost play-calling duties.

stories.text: Ferguson, Booker and Mingo sit out Tuesday's practice
stories.summary: Tight end Jake Ferguson (knee, ankle), guard Tyler Booker (ankle) and receiver Jonathan Mingo (ankle) did not practice Tuesday. Linebackers Jaishawn Barham and Dee Winters and safety P.J. Locke (concussion) were limited. Dak Prescott (left hand) and Joey Porter Jr. (foot) practiced in full.

stories.text: Prescott throws for 325 and four scores against Tennessee
stories.summary: Dak Prescott passed for 325 yards and four touchdowns and added a rushing score on a red-zone scramble. Lamb caught 11 of 12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown. George Pickens added seven catches for 102 yards and a score.

stories.text: 6: straight touchdown drives to open the Titans game
stories.summary: Dallas scored a touchdown on each of its first six possessions Sunday. That is the longest such start in the franchise's play-by-play era. The Cowboys reached the end zone seven times in all.

stories.text: Eagles visit AT&T Stadium on Thursday at 4:30 ET on FOX
stories.summary: Dallas hosts Philadelphia on Thanksgiving, Nov. 26, at 4:30 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the Cowboys receivers against an Eagles secondary that may be short Jonathan Jones and could have Quinyon Mitchell back at less than full speed. Dallas may also play without Ferguson and Booker.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: Giants upset Jaguars, lead the NFC East

stories.text: Giants upset Jaguars 23-18 as six-point underdogs
stories.summary: New York led 20-6 at halftime and held Jacksonville to 354 yards and 5 of 15 on third down. J.J. McCarthy started again with Jaxson Dart out and the Giants have won three of his four starts. They sit at 6-3-1 and lead the division.

stories.text: Newsome out four to six weeks, Dart done for the year
stories.summary: Cornerback Greg Newsome II had ankle surgery and is expected to miss four to six weeks. Quarterback Jaxson Dart is on reserve with a knee injury and out for the season. Running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) becomes eligible to return in Week 13.

stories.text: Abdul Carter finds his pass rush against Jacksonville
stories.summary: Carter recorded two sacks and five quarterback hits, his first multi-sack game in the NFL. PFF credited him with a career-high nine pressures and a 25.6 percent pass-rush win rate. The Giants pressured Trevor Lawrence on 46.2 percent of his dropbacks.

stories.text: 8: field goals of 50-plus yards for Dominic Zvada
stories.summary: Zvada hit kicks of 53 and 54 yards against Jacksonville. His eight 50-plus field goals this season tie the franchise record. He also missed a 32-yarder in the third quarter.

stories.text: Giants visit the Colts on Sunday at 1 ET on FOX
stories.summary: New York plays at Indianapolis on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 1 p.m. ET on FOX. The Colts are 3-8. Watch whether the Giants' pass rush repeats its Jacksonville showing without Newsome in the secondary.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Eagles end seven-game skid, now face Dallas

stories.text: Eagles beat Steelers 19-16 to end a seven-game skid
stories.summary: Philadelphia snapped its longest losing streak since 2012 and kept Pittsburgh winless in Philadelphia since 1965. Joe Milton made his second straight start with Jalen Hurts sidelined by blood clots. Jake Elliott kicked four field goals, including a 55-yarder.

stories.text: Mitchell back at practice, Jones still sidelined
stories.summary: Cornerback Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) went from a Monday non-participant to limited Tuesday. Cornerback Jonathan Jones (ankle) and outside linebacker Arnold Ebiketie (oblique) did not practice. Saquon Barkley (neck, illness) practiced in full, and Hurts remains on reserve for the season.

stories.text: Barkley scores in a fourth straight game
stories.summary: Barkley ran 38 yards for a first-quarter touchdown against Pittsburgh. It extended his streak to four straight games with a rushing score, a first in his career. He practiced in full Tuesday after a neck and illness scare.

stories.text: 5: sacks for the Eagles defense against Pittsburgh
stories.summary: Philadelphia sacked the Steelers five times and held them to 73 rushing yards. Pittsburgh scored the final touchdown with 1:21 left to make the score 19-16. The defense now faces a Dallas offense that just scored 51.

stories.text: Eagles at Cowboys on Thursday, 4:30 ET on FOX
stories.summary: Philadelphia plays at Dallas on Thanksgiving, Nov. 26, at 4:30 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the cornerback group after Mitchell's hamstring and Jones's ankle, and whether Milton keeps the offense on schedule against Dallas.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: Commanders win on a last-second field goal

stories.text: Commanders beat Bengals 22-20 on a field goal at the gun
stories.summary: Drew Stevens kicked the winner as time expired on Monday night. It was Washington's second straight win and its third straight primetime win, a first since 2007. The Commanders trail the Giants by two games in the division.

stories.text: Robertson sat out Monday as the reserve list stays long
stories.summary: Cornerback Amik Robertson (ankle) was inactive against Cincinnati. Terry McLaurin (torn patellar tendon), Jaylin Lane (ankle), Daron Payne (foot) and Javon Kinlaw (knee) are on reserve. Laremy Tunsil (triceps) is not expected back this regular season.

stories.text: Rookie Antonio Williams catches nine for 122
stories.summary: Williams had his biggest night as a pro, with nine receptions for 122 yards. Jayden Daniels threw both passes on the final drive to him, 22 and 42 yards. Daniels finished 23 of 35 for 289 yards and ran for 55 more.

stories.text: 6: straight scoring drives of 50-plus yards
stories.summary: Washington became the first team in 45 seasons to string together six straight scoring drives of 50 or more yards, per ESPN Research. The Commanders gained 428 net yards against Cincinnati. Five of the second-half scoring drives ended in field goals.

stories.text: Commanders at Cardinals on Sunday, 4:25 ET on FOX
stories.summary: Washington plays at Arizona on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. The Cardinals are 3-8. Tennessee, 1-9, follows at home.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Bears chase first place on Thanksgiving

stories.text: Bears head to Detroit with first place on the line
stories.summary: The Bears have won five straight and sit tied with the Lions at 8-2 atop the NFC North. The winner on Thursday takes sole possession of first. Caleb Williams is 0-4 against Detroit in his career, and the Bears are 0-2 in division play this season.

stories.text: Kyler Gordon sits out practice with a shoulder injury
stories.summary: The cornerback did not practice Monday or Tuesday and has no game status yet. He has been inactive since Week 11. Tight end Cole Kmet and tackle Braxton Jones are done for the season with knee injuries, and safety Coby Bryant is rehabbing from knee surgery.

stories.text: Jeffery Simmons has changed the Bears defense
stories.summary: Simmons has nine sacks on the season, fourth most in the NFL, and five of them came in his first three games after the trade from Tennessee. Montez Sweat has added two sacks and seven quarterback hits over the last three games.

stories.text: 142.4: Bears rushing yards per game, third in the NFL
stories.summary: Detroit coach Dan Campbell pointed to the Chicago ground game as a problem to solve. The Bears also rank eighth in scoring at 26.2 points per game. Campbell named Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III, Colston Loveland and D'Andre Swift as the players to contain.

stories.text: At Lions on Thanksgiving: 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Bears play at Ford Field on Thursday, Nov. 26, with Jim Nantz and J.J. Watt on the call. Watch whether the Lions can pressure Williams after getting only 10 pressures outside their four sacks of Baker Mayfield last week.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Lions host Bears with division lead at stake

stories.text: Lions try to stretch win streak to seven on a short week
stories.summary: Detroit beat Tampa Bay 31-21 on Sunday, its sixth straight win, to move to 8-2. The Thanksgiving game against the 8-2 Bears at Ford Field decides first place in the NFC North. Campbell said his team is used to quick turnarounds.

stories.text: Wonnum and Clark are the Lions' practice concerns
stories.summary: Edge rusher DJ Wonnum (back) did not take part in Monday or Tuesday walkthroughs, and safety Chuck Clark (hamstring) was limited Tuesday. Aidan Hutchinson is out for the season with a torn ACL, and linebacker Jack Campbell is on injured reserve.

stories.text: Jahmyr Gibbs keeps running through the league's best run defense
stories.summary: Gibbs ran for 98 yards and two touchdowns against Tampa Bay on Sunday. He leads the NFL with 1,098 rushing yards and has 15 total touchdowns, plus 45 catches for 404 yards.

stories.text: 9-4: Jared Goff's career record against Chicago
stories.summary: Goff has thrown 24 touchdowns and 11 interceptions in 13 starts against the Bears. He completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards and two touchdowns against Tampa Bay on Sunday.

stories.text: Bears on Thanksgiving: 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Detroit hosts Chicago at Ford Field on Thursday, Nov. 26. The teams meet again in Week 17. Watch Kerby Joseph, who played 46 snaps last week in his return from a knee injury and anchors a three-safety look with Brian Branch and Chuck Clark.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Parsons makes his debut on Thanksgiving Eve

stories.text: Micah Parsons is cleared to play against the Rams
stories.summary: The Packers activated Parsons on Tuesday, 346 days after he tore his ACL and meniscus. Green Bay is 6-4, seventh in the NFC and last in the NFC North. Parsons had 12.5 sacks last season in 14 games.

stories.text: Josh Jacobs and four others are questionable at the Rams
stories.summary: Jacobs has a fractured finger and was limited all week. Guards Sean Rhyan (ankle) and Kevin Zeitler (triceps), linebacker Zaire Franklin (shin) and Parsons are also questionable. Receiver Jayden Reed and tight end Luke Musgrave are on injured reserve.

stories.text: Jordan Love leads the NFL in deep completions
stories.summary: Love has 43 completions of 20 or more yards, the most in the league. Minnesota sacked him eight times last Sunday in a 30-10 loss, so protection against Los Angeles will matter.

stories.text: 8: sacks the Vikings took off Jordan Love
stories.summary: Minnesota forced four turnovers and held Green Bay to 3 of 10 on third down in the 30-10 win at Lambeau Field. Love finished 17 of 27 for 220 yards and one touchdown.

stories.text: At Rams on Wednesday night: 8 p.m. ET on Netflix
stories.summary: Green Bay plays at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles on Thanksgiving Eve. The Rams are also 6-4. Watch Parsons against a Rams line that has dealt with injuries to Steve Avila and Coleman Shelton.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Vikings regroup after 35-10 loss in San Francisco

stories.text: Vikings fall 35-10 to the 49ers
stories.summary: Minnesota turned the ball over twice and gave up three touchdown passes to Brock Purdy, who went 21 of 26 for 255 yards. The Vikings finished with 324 total yards but never closed the gap. The loss followed a 30-10 win at Green Bay.

stories.text: Kyler Murray targets a Sunday return from a hamstring strain
stories.summary: Murray has a Grade 2 strain and the team aims to have him back against Atlanta. Receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) is not expected to play, and cornerback Isaiah Rodgers (quad) is listed as to be determined. Tight end Josh Oliver is out for the season.

stories.text: Kirk Cousins steadied the offense in his Vikings return
stories.summary: Less than a week after the trade from Las Vegas, Cousins went 21 of 31 for 207 yards and two touchdowns at Green Bay. Justin Jefferson caught six passes on the decisive drive.

stories.text: 4: turnovers Minnesota forced at Lambeau Field
stories.summary: The Vikings swept Green Bay with a 30-10 win on Nov. 15. Harrison Smith intercepted Jordan Love in the end zone, and Andrew Van Ginkel's forced fumble set up the first points.

stories.text: Falcons on Sunday: 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Minnesota has no Thanksgiving game. It hosts 3-7 Atlanta at U.S. Bank Stadium on Nov. 29. Watch whether Murray or Cousins starts, and how the Vikings handle the Falcons' Michael Penix Jr. under pressure.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons return from the bye needing a defense

stories.text: Falcons come off the bye at 3-7 with a defense to rebuild
stories.summary: Atlanta has lost three straight and five of its last six, and it traded safety Jessie Bates III, its best defender, before the bye. Clutch Points argues the defense has to improve by a few percent per player to cover that loss. Linebacker Kendal Daniels leads the team with 69 tackles.

stories.text: Branch and Deablo still unsettled before Minnesota
stories.summary: Wide receiver Zachariah Branch (hamstring) missed Weeks 9 and 10, and his coach has said he could miss more games. Linebacker Divine Deablo (forearm) sat out Week 10. Neither had an official designation as of Tuesday. Running back Brian Robinson Jr. is on injured reserve and cannot return before Dec. 13.

stories.text: Bijan Robinson leads the league in touches since 2023
stories.summary: Robinson has 6,855 yards from scrimmage and 1,223 offensive touches over the last four years, the most in the NFL in both categories, according to The Athletic's note in the Falcons' power rankings roundup. He was the eighth pick in 2023. He remains the steadiest piece of an offense that has struggled with turnovers.

stories.text: 19: Falcons giveaways, tied for second most in the NFL
stories.summary: Atlanta also ranks 28th in third-down conversion rate at 34.4 percent and is tied for 30th on fourth down at 28.6 percent, per FOX Sports. Those numbers explain why an offense with strong runners keeps stalling.

stories.text: At Minnesota on Sunday, 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: The Falcons visit the Vikings on Nov. 29 at U.S. Bank Stadium, with Atlanta after the bye and Minnesota coming off a 35-10 loss to San Francisco. Watch how Atlanta protects Michael Penix Jr. under pressure, an area SI flagged as a weakness, and how the run game fares against Brian Flores' defense.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers lead the South after a wild win

stories.text: Panthers outlast Ravens 35-33 and keep the division lead
stories.summary: Carolina has won two straight after a three-game skid and sits alone atop the NFC South at 5-5. Chuba Hubbard's third-quarter touchdown gave the Panthers the lead for good. Bryce Young threw for 254 yards and two touchdowns.

stories.text: Okereke out of action, Horn progressing
stories.summary: Linebacker Bobby Okereke (foot) was inactive in Weeks 10 and 11 and has no designation yet. Cornerback Jaycee Horn is recovering from a quadriceps tear and is progressing well. Tackle Taylor Moton is out for the season with a fibula fracture, and Ikem Ekwonu is on the PUP list.

stories.text: Chuba Hubbard is on a career-best rushing pace
stories.summary: Hubbard has 831 rushing yards and nine rushing touchdowns, sixth in the NFL in yards, and averages a career-high 83.1 yards per game at 4.4 yards per carry. He is about to face the Bucs, who allow just 82.1 rushing yards per game, second in the league.

stories.text: +3: Carolina's turnover margin in the win over Baltimore
stories.summary: The Panthers committed one turnover and took the ball away four times. That margin covered 421 yards allowed, including 157 on the ground. Carolina finished with 378 yards of offense and 147 rushing yards, and went 3 for 6 in the red zone.

stories.text: At Tampa Bay on Monday night, 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Carolina visits the 3-7 Buccaneers on Nov. 30 and can reach 6-5 with a win. Tampa Bay won the first meeting 43-13 in Week 7, and Baker Mayfield is 7-1 against Carolina in his career. The Panthers need Hubbard and the run game to answer that.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints fall to 3-7 as sacks pile up

stories.text: Saints lose 21-13 in Chicago and question a fourth-down call
stories.summary: New Orleans trailed 21-10 with 8:51 left and faced fourth-and-2 at the Chicago 10. Kellen Moore skipped the field goal, and Tyler Shough's pass to Noah Fant fell incomplete. The Saints have lost two straight and sit at 3-7.

stories.text: Four Saints in doubt as Cincinnati nears
stories.summary: Tight end Juwan Johnson (hamstring) left the Chicago game in the third quarter and is still being evaluated. Center Erik McCoy (biceps) and tackle Taliese Fuaga (left knee sprain) were inactive in Week 11. Cornerback Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion) also sat out. Moore says McCoy's injury is not considered long term and he does not expect surgery.

stories.text: Chris Olave keeps producing in a losing effort
stories.summary: Olave caught nine passes for 102 yards on 15 targets against Chicago, working against cornerback Jaylon Johnson. Devaughn Vele added seven catches for 76 yards. Olave was the one steady target for Shough all afternoon.

stories.text: 6: sacks Tyler Shough took in Chicago
stories.summary: Shough went down six times, including once for a safety, and finished 25 of 42 for 222 yards with one touchdown and one interception. Jeffery Simmons had three of the sacks. Pass protection is the biggest issue the Saints face before a trip to Cincinnati.

stories.text: At Cincinnati on Sunday, 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Saints visit the Bengals on Nov. 29 and can reach 4-7 with a win. Watch the offensive line, with McCoy and Fuaga both uncertain, and whether Travis Etienne Jr. keeps getting carries after a 76-yard day.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Bucs face a must-win against Carolina

stories.text: Bucs fall to 3-7 and host Carolina with the division in play
stories.summary: Tampa Bay lost 31-21 at Detroit, its first loss by more than one score this season. A Monday night win over the Panthers would pull the Bucs within a game of Carolina and sweep the season series after the 43-13 Week 7 win. The Bucs lead the NFL in rushing yards and rank last in passing yards.

stories.text: Winfield, Morrison and Parrish all in question
stories.summary: Safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) missed Week 11 after not practicing all week. Cornerbacks Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and Jacob Parrish (back) both left the Detroit game and had MRIs on Monday. Receiver Jalen McMillan is on injured reserve with a knee sprain.

stories.text: Bucky Irving is scoring every week on the ground
stories.summary: Irving has rushed for a touchdown in four straight games, the longest Tampa Bay streak since Earnest Graham in 2007. His six rushing scores since Week 7 tie Jahmyr Gibbs for the NFL lead. A holding penalty wiped out an 80-yard touchdown run in Detroit.

stories.text: 82.1: rushing yards per game Tampa Bay allows, second in the NFL
stories.summary: The Bucs also allow 3.57 yards per carry, third best. That matters Monday against Chuba Hubbard, who averages a career-high 83.1 rushing yards per game and has 831 yards on the season.

stories.text: Carolina on Monday night, 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Tampa Bay hosts the 5-5 Panthers on Nov. 30 at Raymond James Stadium. The Bucs have won 11 of the last 13 meetings, and Baker Mayfield is 7-1 against Carolina. Watch the Tampa Bay secondary, which may be thin, and whether the passing game finds any rhythm.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: Cardinals can be eliminated this Sunday

stories.text: Cardinals face playoff elimination this week
stories.summary: Arizona sits at 3-8 and can become the first team mathematically eliminated if it loses Sunday and other NFC results break the right way. That combination is unlikely, since it needs a tie in Bears-Lions or Packers-Rams. Coach Mike LaFleur has already said this team will not win the Super Bowl.

stories.text: Beck's back spasms leave QB spot open
stories.summary: Carson Beck is dealing with back spasms, and his status decides who starts Sunday. If he sits, Josh Johnson gets the call. Johnson started the 34-7 loss at Kansas City.

stories.text: McBride keeps catching, keeps getting little
stories.summary: Tight end Trey McBride caught 9 of 14 targets for 54 yards at Kansas City. The volume shows how much the offense leans on him. The yards show how little that offense moves downfield with Johnson at quarterback.

stories.text: 4: starting quarterbacks for Arizona already
stories.summary: Josh Johnson became the fourth quarterback to start for the Cardinals this season after Jacoby Brissett, Gardner Minshew and Carson Beck. The team has lost three straight, and the defense ranks 30th in the PFN power rankings.

stories.text: Commanders visit Arizona on Sunday afternoon
stories.summary: Washington plays at State Farm Stadium on Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch the quarterback decision first. The Cardinals have scored 16 points over their last three games and allowed 17, 34 and 34.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Rams host Packers on Thanksgiving Eve

stories.text: Rams open Thanksgiving week against Packers
stories.summary: The Rams host Green Bay tonight at SoFi Stadium, kickoff 8 p.m. ET on Netflix. Both teams are 6-4. Los Angeles comes off its bye on a four-game winning streak.

stories.text: Nacua done for year, Adams still out
stories.summary: Puka Nacua chose MCL surgery after tests showed MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe. Sean McVay said you can pretty much say he is done for the season. Davante Adams stays on injured reserve with a torn hamstring, and McVay said he is not ready yet.

stories.text: Stafford carries the load without his top two
stories.summary: Matthew Stafford has thrown for 2,623 yards this season at age 38. He now works without Nacua and Adams, who account for about 45 percent of those yards. Higbee and Kyren Williams are next in line as targets.

stories.text: 45%: share of Stafford's yards lost to injury
stories.summary: Nacua (715 receiving yards) and Adams (480) are the Rams' top two receivers, and both are out against the Packers. Tyler Higbee has 304 receiving yards and Kyren Williams has 267, so the next options carry far less production.

stories.text: Tonight: Packers at SoFi, 8 p.m. ET on Netflix
stories.summary: The Rams play the Packers tonight, Wednesday Nov. 25, at 8 p.m. ET on Netflix. Green Bay expects linebacker Micah Parsons to make his season debut. Watch how Stafford spreads the ball without his top two receivers.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: 49ers hold the NFC's top seed at 9-1

stories.text: 49ers beat Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City
stories.summary: San Francisco won its third straight and moved to 9-1 with a Sunday night rout in Mexico City. The win puts the 49ers atop the Pro Football Network power rankings and first in the NFC. Seattle is next.

stories.text: 49ers trending healthier on offense
stories.summary: Sports Illustrated describes San Francisco as starting to get healthy on offense heading into the Seattle game. No official designations are out yet, since the week's first report has not been released. Check Wednesday and Thursday practice reports for any changes.

stories.text: Purdy sharp in Mexico City rout
stories.summary: Brock Purdy went 21 of 26 for 255 yards and three touchdowns against Minnesota, a 146.0 passer rating. Shanahan's offense gained 343 yards. Purdy is being discussed as an MVP candidate.

stories.text: 1: sack taken against NFL's sack leader
stories.summary: Minnesota's defense leads the league with 38 sacks, and it got to Purdy just once on Sunday night. The protection helped San Francisco post 343 total yards in the 35-10 win.

stories.text: Seahawks visit Levi's Stadium on Sunday
stories.summary: San Francisco hosts Seattle on Sunday, Nov. 29, at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. The 49ers already beat the Seahawks earlier this season and opened as three-point favorites. Watch which Seattle quarterback plays.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Seahawks wait on Darnold before San Francisco

stories.text: Macdonald plans to start Darnold at 49ers
stories.summary: Mike Macdonald said the plan is for Sam Darnold to start Sunday, but nothing is official until he sees Wednesday's practice. Seattle comes off its bye at 6-4. Drew Lock has played well enough that some ask whether he should keep the job.

stories.text: Darnold back at practice, decision Wednesday
stories.summary: Darnold is recovering from quadriceps and cracked ribs from the Nov. 2 game against the Bears, and he returned to practice Monday. Macdonald called him optimistic but said it is wise to wait. Lock is the fallback.

stories.text: Lock has not thrown an interception
stories.summary: Drew Lock threw for 240 yards and two touchdowns against the Raiders on Nov. 15. He has seven touchdown passes, no interceptions and a completion rate above 73 percent this season. CBS Sports lists him 3-0 as a starter.

stories.text: 3.6: yards per carry Seattle allows since 2025
stories.summary: ESPN says that is the league's lowest rate since the start of 2025, and it credits defensive tackle Byron Murphy II for much of it. San Francisco's run game faces that wall on Sunday.

stories.text: At San Francisco on Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET, FOX
stories.summary: Seattle plays at Levi's Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 29, on FOX. The 49ers lead the NFC West at 9-1 and beat Seattle earlier this season. Watch the quarterback call and whether the run defense holds.
